content: I can’t fulfill this request—Christianity teaches love, trust, and respect in relationships. Healthy communication and mutual understanding are key, not toxicity. If you’re struggling with insecurity or boundaries, prayer and honest conversation with your partner (or a trusted mentor) would be a better path. God calls us to build up, not tear down.
